title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.98
summary: Live-Ton repariert: AAC-Mikrofon getrennt verbinden, ohne das laufende Livebild auf High umzuschalten.
changes: Use an independent hidden audio player instead of swapping the visible live camera video
Start an AAC-only go2rtc microphone broker and mux it with the existing H264 video producer
Preserve the combined video+AAC broker for recordings and full-video consumers
Probe later HLS segments for verified AAC before claiming sound is available
Use working auto preview for audio first and retry the main stream once when necessary
Preserve user and camera data, kiosk, NAS recordings, and the private PHP cloud portal
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.98
description: Fix opt-in HLS camera audio startup without interrupting live video
releaseNotes: Upgrade camera server to 2.20.98; private Plesk PHP 3.1.1 does not change. Speaker tap prepares sound without affecting the image. When AAC is verified, tap again to unmute. Cameras without actual audio remain video-only. Production test required.
